sources.snippet: LIBERO is designed for studying knowledge transfer in multitask and lifelong robot learning problems. Successfully resolving these problems require both declarative knowledge about objects/spatial relationships and procedural knowledge about motion/behaviors. LIBERO provides: a procedural generation pipeline that could in principle generate an infinite number of manipulation tasks. 130 tasks ...
